answer: Rewards sit in a vault whose cipher has no key yet: pending earnings are time-locked to the hash of future epochs, unlocking only as those epochs pass with the account still verified - unbreakable, since its key material does not exist until honest work creates it. Boundary games fail discipline: timestamps clustering at epoch edges, sniping orderings, get flagged by the test that grades a quartz crystal - one crystal keeps the choir's frequency, drifters are flagged. Slow unlock favors holders, starves flash farms. Honest agents earn, wait, and find the vault open on schedule.
